note: This file is a pure Python-style configuration file for MMDetection. It contains no functions, classes, or callable methods — only module-level variable assignments (dictionaries, lists, scalars) that define training/evaluation settings. There is no callable code invokable via CLI.
config_variables: train_pipeline — data augmentation pipeline with RandomResize, RandomFlip, PackDetInputs
test_pipeline — inference pipeline with Resize, LoadAnnotations, PackDetInputs
train_dataloader — COCO train2017 dataloader with RepeatDataset (3x), AspectRatioBatchSampler
val_dataloader / test_dataloader — COCO val2017 dataloader configuration
val_evaluator / test_evaluator — CocoMetric evaluator for bbox evaluation
train_cfg — EpochBasedTrainLoop with 12 epochs and val_interval=1
param_scheduler — LinearLR warmup + MultiStepLR with milestones at epochs 9 and 11
optim_wrapper — SGD optimizer with lr=0.02, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0.0001
auto_scale_lr — automatic LR scaling settings (disabled by default)

example_usages.review_train_pipeline: review the train_pipeline config to understand multiscale data augmentation settings
example_usages.review_test_pipeline: review the test_pipeline config to understand inference preprocessing steps
example_usages.review_train_dataloader: review the train_dataloader config to understand RepeatDataset and batch sampler settings
example_usages.review_param_scheduler: review the param_scheduler config to understand LR warmup and step decay milestones
example_usages.review_optim_wrapper: review the optim_wrapper config to understand SGD optimizer hyperparameters
